evd_title: GAR achieved a Bradley-Terry preference score of 0.684 outperforming human reviewers at 0.523 in GPT-4 preference evaluation
finding: GAR achieved a Bradley-Terry preference score of 0.684 outperforming human reviewers at 0.523 in GPT-4 preference evaluation
P: 200 ICLR 2023 papers (OpenReview), 2 randomly assigned reviews per paper
I: GAR reviewer agent (graph-based paper representation, memory, persona modules), GPT-4o-mini backbone
C: Human OpenReview reviews; AI-Scientist, ReviewerGPT (anchor), AI-Review, OpenReviewer (all GPT-4o-mini)
O: Bradley-Terry (GPT-4o judge): GAR 0.684 vs human 0.523, AI-Scientist 0.242, ReviewerGPT 0.000, OpenReviewer -0.632; paired t p<0.002
